title: P0 core understanding: purpose, philosophy, architecture, and boundaries
rawUserRequest: 查收，执行计划。我授权给你，并写入Contract。

declaredIntent.requestedOutcome: Make the project's North Star, purpose, design philosophy, architecture, and capability boundaries understandable to non-technical readers in English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

outOfScope: Decision states, lifecycle, recovery, installation, calibration, first Work Item, and security overview content; these remain successor P0 Work Items.
Full translation of P1/P2 technical references or the complete capability matrix reference tables.
Runtime behavior, product capability implementation, release metadata, version tags, and publication.
Historical documents under docs/archive/ except generated Work Item archive evidence.

sources.reason: Approved P0 writing contract, navigation rules, semantic invariants, and WI-3 boundaries.
Current topic ownership, localized paths, criticality, and migration status.
Merged WI-2 reader journey and planned destinations.
Existing active P0 trust-layer authority and product boundary facts.
Current public identity, boundary, and entry-layer wording.

intent.problem: The project's most important understanding—North Star, purpose, philosophy, architecture, and boundaries—is either missing, mislabeled, or silently routed through mixed-language pages. Non-technical readers need a trustworthy three-language explanation before technical reference.
constraints: Complete only the core understanding P0 topics assigned to WI-3; decisions, lifecycle, adoption, recovery, and security closure remain successor Work Items.
Preserve existing Trust Layer, installation, quality-gate, capability evidence, and authority-boundary facts; do not upgrade claims without evidence.
Japanese and Simplified Chinese must be semantically equivalent and understandable without requiring full translation of P1/P2 depth.
Do not change runtime behavior, release metadata, version tags, or historical documentation.
intent.rationale: The localized homes now expose the journey; completing its core conceptual pages removes the project-understanding bottleneck before readers encounter adoption and operational detail.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item changes authoritative public explanations in three languages; incorrect boundary or North Star wording could mislead adoption decisions.

reasons: P0 canonical documentation, localized siblings, registry migration state, and structural tests require full repository verification.

executionDecision.reason: User authorization and the approved WI-3 design provide sufficient scope, sources, acceptance, and verification evidence.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and finish to detect documentation-scope or evidence drift.

acceptance: Create complete same-topic English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese P0 pages for project purpose, design philosophy, project architecture, and capability boundaries; each begins with the P0 writing contract and progressive disclosure.
Make the North Star and project identity explicit in all three root/localized journeys, with one canonical owner and no contradictory mission or product-boundary wording.

Ensure each localized core page has one to three same-language next steps, is reachable from its matching documentation home within two links, and contains no silent English fallback on the core P0 route.

Update the authority registry so migrated topics have canonical localized paths and active status only when all three siblings and their tests are present; preserve existing active topics and planned successor topics.
Add positive and negative structural tests for P0 writing-contract sections, locale parity, same-language navigation, registry ownership, and boundary invariants; focused documentation checks pass.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A non-technical reader follows the English, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese understanding route from identity to architecture.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reader can explain the problem, North Star, evidence flow, product boundary, and safe next step without relying on implementation knowledge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run localized P0 structure and link-graph tests, then record a bounded comprehension review checklist in the Summary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A reader decides whether AI Cockpit controls a capability or whether responsibility remains external.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reader distinguishes Repository Governance Layer responsibilities from Agent Runtime, Security Sandbox, identity, enterprise, and delegated evidence responsibilities.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run boundary-invariant tests across all localized siblings and inspect the explicit non-capability sections during review.

guidelines: Use the P0 writing contract: purpose, audience, outcome, scenario, explanation, action/decision, stop conditions, next steps, then technical depth.
Keep North Star, evidence-over-self-declaration, human decision authority, and Repository Governance Layer boundaries semantically equivalent across locales.
Do not claim full multilingual coverage for P0 topics that remain planned outside this Work Item.
Use one canonical owner per topic and keep directory/reference pages as explicit compatibility or specialist routes.
Do not modify runtime behavior, release metadata, or historical documentation.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted governance paths are required.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore the previous canonical documentation paths and registry status.
